verdict.rationale: Mesh can be driven entirely without the UI. Machine-to-machine OAuth2 client-credentials API keys with scoped permissions and expiry, plus a username/password legacy option, let unattended jobs authenticate. Synchronous, asynchronous and batch screening APIs, webhooks and status polling, and rate-limit headers support automated pipelines, and a Postman collection and OpenAPI schema aid scripting. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific integration guidance, an OpenAPI spec at standard machine-discoverable paths (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
